The post-call telemetry blocks (success logging and spend recording) at runner.py:547-565 and runner.py:583-599 must be extracted into log_call_success() and record_call_spend() functions in agent_call.py

PydanticAIRunner.run() must be reduced from 342 lines to approximately 300 lines by this extraction, and agent_call.py must clear the 100-LOC anti-fragmentation floor without violating the 800-LOC module ceiling
